The paper describes the development of two dilute Al-Sc-Zr alloys:
1. Alloy 1: Al-0.09 Sc-0.045 Zr at.% (Al-0.15 Sc-0.15 Zr wt.%)
2. Alloy 2: Al-0.06 Sc-0.03 Zr at.% (Al-0.10 Sc-0.10 Zr wt.%)

The alloys underwent a two-step aging treatment: 300°C for 4h followed by 425°C for 8h. The paper also discusses Al-MMC (metal matrix composite) variants with Saffil short alumina fibers at 0%, 4%, and 15% volume fractions.

For comparison, properties of other alloys are mentioned:
- AA5083-H131: UTS of 310 MPa, elongation of 12%, toughness of 35.7 MJ/m³
- AA6061-T6: UTS of 310 MPa, elongation of 12%, toughness of 35.2 MJ/m³
- Al-2Cu wt.%: YS of 69 MPa
property mapping:
- Microhardness (MPa) → Hardness
- Hardness UNIT → MPa (Vickers microhardness measured with 100g load)
- YS → Yield strength (MPa)
- UTS → Ultimate tensile strength (MPa)
- Elongation (%) → elong [%]
abbreviations:
- Al-MMC: Aluminum Metal Matrix Composite
- Saffil: Trade name for high-purity crystalline alumina fibers (>96 vol.% Al₂O₃)
- at.%: Atomic percentage
- wt.%: Weight percentage
